header.subtitle: why AI answers arrive word by word

source.label: THE MODEL
source.sub: writes one word at a time

slow.title: NO STREAMING
slow.sub: the reply waits until it's done

fast.title: STREAMING
fast.sub: each word shows as it's made

payloads: the model wrote this whole reply three seconds ago but the buffer held every token back until the very last word had been written down and marked as fully done
streaming does not change how fast the model thinks it only changes when you are allowed to start reading the words it has already finished writing down just for you

captions.text: why does AI type word by word?
finished words were sitting in a buffer.
streaming sends each word the moment it exists.
you start reading at word one, not thirty.

credits.tail: = send each word as it's born
